KMDR-against and CLIMAX-against both fired on/just before that bar while ER10 collapsed from 0.36 to 0.14, indicating the move was losing trend efficiency right as two independent against-direction detectors triggered together -- took that confluence as a climax/reversal signature rather than risk letting giveback run.
